headline: Lumentum Shares Gain on Report of Possible Acquisition by Marvell
summary: Lumentum stock gained following a report that the company could reach a sale agreement with Marvell Technology as early as next week.
why: Lumentum is an optical and photonic component manufacturer, components that are critical for optical networking and AI data center interconnects.

impacts.name: Lumentum Holdings Inc
impacts.why: Shares rallied on reports that the company may be acquired at a potential deal premium.

impacts.name: Marvell Technology Inc
impacts.why: Acquisitions can create strategic expansion opportunities but also carry execution and financing risks.

why_moved: Lumentum shares rose after Bloomberg reported that semiconductor firm Marvell could agree to buy the company as soon as next week.
